extracted.intended_audience: music journalists, album reviewers, editors, and critics
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and criteria for deciding an album's newsworthiness and for evaluating album quality across songwriting, performance, production, originality, and genre-specific priorities. Intended to guide music journalists and reviewers in producing and selecting reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major artist release
rubrics_metrics.description: Established act
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'What Makes an Album Worth Reviewing (Newsworthiness)' — an album by a well-known or established artist significantly drives newsworthiness and whether a review is assigned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highly anticipated debut or follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: A debut or follow-up release that carries substantial public or critical anticipation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipation (public, critical, or industry) is a factor in choosing to cover and prioritize a review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical buzz / pre-release attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-release media attention or early critical praise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums generating significant pre-release discussion or advance reviews are more likely to be considered newsworthy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre significance
rubrics_metrics.description: A defining moment for a movement or important within its genre
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the release signals a shift, milestone, or critical development within a genre, it increases newsworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural moment alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: An album that aligns with or illuminates a broader cultural moment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Releases that connect to timely cultural, political, or social conversations are more likely to be reviewed as news.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissue / archival significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Reissues, remasters, or archival releases with historical importance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Releases that surface important historical material, newly curated archives, or definitive reissues merit review for their archival value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posthumous release
rubrics_metrics.description: An album released after an artist's death
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posthumous albums carry inherent news and cultural interest, meriting contextual review and commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surprise drop
rubrics_metrics.description: An unannounced release that creates immediate news
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unexpected releases that generate instant public attention are newsworthy based on the surprise and reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controversy associated with album or artist
rubrics_metrics.description: Controversy tied to the release or artist surrounding it
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controversial circumstances or debates around an album or artist boost newsworthiness and editorial interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local artist in local press
rubrics_metrics.description: Releases by local artists that are significant to regional audiences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local publications prioritize coverage of artists with regional relevance or community impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrates new style or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: An album that showcases new stylistic approaches or production/tech advances
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Releases that push technical or stylistic boundaries are newsworthy for innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anniversary or retrospective angle
rubrics_metrics.description: Anniversary editions or releases that invite retrospective coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Milestone dates and retrospectives provide editorial hooks for revisiting or re-evaluating albums.

rubrics_metrics.name: Songwriting & Structure: Strength of melodies, hooks, lyrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation of melody strength, hook effectiveness, and lyric quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess musical ideas, memorability, lyrical craft, and how individual songs succeed as compositions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Songwriting & Structure: Verses, choruses, bridges, transitions, dynamics
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of formal song elements — sections, transitions, and dynamic shaping
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine how sections build or resolve, how transitions maintain momentum, and how dynamics serve emotional/structural goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Songwriting & Structure: Album coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Cohesion across tracks and the album-level arc (not just track-level quality)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider sequencing, thematic unity, pacing, and whether the album functions as a coherent statement rather than a collection of singles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocal & Performance: Emotional authenticity
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree to which vocal delivery conveys genuine emotion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether performances feel convincing and emotionally resonant rather than merely competent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocal & Performance: Phrasing and presence
rubrics_metrics.description: Vocal phrasing, presence, and interpretive choices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess nuance in delivery, timing, and how performers inhabit the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocal & Performance: Instrumental virtuosity
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical skill and expressive command of instruments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider musicianship, technical feats, ensemble interplay, and moments of instrumental distinction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production: Mixing and mastering quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The technical quality of mixing and mastering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate balance, clarity, use of space, loudness, and whether production choices serve the music.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production: Sound clarity and balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall sonic clarity and instrumental/vocal balance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge how well elements occupy the mix, whether important details are audible, and whether the spectrum is coherent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production: Sonic identity / palette
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinctive production choices that create an identifiable sonic palette
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether production shapes a unique or appropriate sonic world for the material and contributes to originality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality & Listenability: Distinctive style / sonic choices
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree to which the album exhibits a distinctive stylistic voice or unique sonic decisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure originality in composition, arrangement, instrumentation, and production choices that differentiate the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality & Listenability: Memorable moments / hooks
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of standout moments, hooks, or turns that linger with the listener
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight specific passages, melodies, or lyrical lines that create lasting impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality & Listenability: Repeat listen-ability
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the album rewards multiple listens and sustains interest over time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider depth, detail, and emotional/structural layers that increase replay value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place in artist's catalog
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the album fits within the artist's previous work and overall oeuvre
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextualize the release relative to predecessors and assess progression, regression, or continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare to peers in genre
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating the album against contemporary works in its genre
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use peer comparison to situate quality, originality, and relevance within a scene or field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider intended audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessing how the album serves its target listeners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiate between writing for general readers versus genre fans; judge success relative to intended audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish technical from preferential judgment
rubrics_metrics.description: Separating objective/technical assessment from subjective taste
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be explicit about when criticism is technical (e.g., production flaws) versus purely preferential (e.g., genre taste) and label opinions as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honesty over politeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize truthful critique rather than excessive politeness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are encouraged to be candid while remaining fair and grounded in evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground opinion in audible details
rubrics_metrics.description: Support judgments with concrete, listenable examples
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite specific moments, lines, production choices, or arrangements as evidence for claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Artist prominence drives placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Artist prominence influences whether and where a review is published
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial placement and depth of coverage are often determined by the artist's fame or industry standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Cultural moment frames context
rubrics_metrics.description: Cultural relevance frames how a review is contextualized
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews often situate albums within larger cultural conversations to increase relevance and readership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Originality pushes form forward
rubrics_metrics.description: Albums that push musical forms or expectations are newsworthy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original work that expands genre conventions is prioritized for critical attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Emotional impact
rubrics_metrics.description: The album's capacity to move listeners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emotional resonance contributes both to critical appraisal and newsworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Craft quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Songwriting and production craftsmanship as a basis for evaluation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong craft in composition, arrangement, and production underpins positive critical judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Place in oeuvre (better/worse than predecessors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative judgment about how the album ranks among an artist's other works
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critics assess progression or decline relative to an artist's catalog as part of news/value judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Genre fit or departure
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether an album adheres to or departs from genre expectations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Genre conformity or adventurous departure can both be grounds for review interest and critical commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Lyrical significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Themes and lyrical content that address substantial or timely topics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lyrical depth or topicality increases editorial interest, especially when tied to larger conversations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Live capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the material translates effectively to live performance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consideration of how songs function in performance contexts factors into assessments, especially for touring artists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implicit Newsworthiness: Streaming-era considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: How singles, playlistability, and streaming behaviors affect album evaluation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Account for modern listening habits (singles-driven attention, track-focussed metrics) when judging album-oriented works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres apply different weights
rubrics_metrics.description: Different genres prioritize different evaluation dimensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Guidance by genre — examples given:
- Pop: prioritize hooks and accessibility
- Hip-hop: emphasize lyricism, beats, samples, and vocal delivery
- Jazz: foreground improvisation, ensemble interplay, and originality
- Classical: focus on composition, performance, and recording quality
- Indie: value authenticity, craft, and artistic vision
- Country: emphasize storytelling, voice, and tradition
- Electronic: consider sound design and structural choices
- Folk: prioritize lyrics, voice, and intimacy
Reviewers should weight criteria according to genre conventions and audience expectations.
